prompt: Which of the following is an advantage of a forward-only DNS server configuration versus a full recursive lookup configuration?
choices: A forward-only configuration is often faster than a complete recursive configuration.
A forward-only configuration never needs an Internet connection.
A forward-only configuration is immune to cache poisoning.
A forward-only configuration can host more authoritative zones.
explanation: A forward-only server passes queries to a forwarder that likely already has answers cached, so it is often faster than performing full recursion itself.
